name: Numbeo cost of living

measures.definition: Read on the publisher's page; not copied.
Read on the publisher's page; not copied.

vetted.notes: Crowd-sourced prices and rents; the most complete rent figures, but proprietary: their terms forbid republishing, even under a paid licence.

personalUse: For a person to read. Automated reading (an agent fetching the page) needs the publisher's permission; a figure the person reads there and gives their agent may be kept in that person's cache with the page's address, never committed or published.
caveats: Terms (read 27 Oct 2026): 'Automated data collection methods (such as scraping or crawling) are strictly prohibited unless you have obtained prior written permission from Numbeo.' Personal use is free with credit.
